message.content: {"summary": "In September 2026, Acme Logistics maintained twelve AI tools in use, delivering an estimated 2,873 hours saved at intake, 2,235 measured hours saved, and a net value of 80,988 EUR. The portfolio recorded two incidents this month, with two open incidents remaining. Risk levels span six low, five medium, and one high. Leadership decisions are needed regarding an overdue review for customer email reply drafts, an open high-severity incident for the CV screening helper, low staff usage of the fleet maintenance predictor, and low training completion rates for both the meeting notes summariser and staff policy assistant."}
